title: 12 Best Photography Spots in Chiang Mai
description: Discover Chiang Mai's most photogenic locations, from ancient temples to lush national parks and bustling markets. Capture stunning photos of landscapes, culture, and street life.

places.name: Wat Phra That Doi Suthep
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Capture the long Naga staircase leading to the temple, and don't miss the 360-degree cityscape views from the temple's viewing platforms.

places.name: Tha Pae Gate
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Focus on candid shots of locals and tourists interacting with the pigeons, especially at dawn or dusk when the light is golden.

places.name: Wat Chedi Luang
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Frame the immense chedi against the sky, paying attention to the intricate details of its crumbling facade. Explore the surrounding smaller temples for diverse architectural shots.

places.name: Baan Kang Wat
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Focus on the unique architecture, intricate craft details, and the peaceful daily life of the artisans. The cafes offer great candid opportunities.

places.name: Doi Inthanon National Park - Royal Pagodas
places.priceRange: National Park Entry: 300 THB (approx. $8.30). Pagodas: 40 THB (approx. $1.10)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Capture the pagodas with their surrounding flower gardens, utilizing the dramatic cloud formations or clear blue skies. Wide-angle lens is essential here.

places.name: Warorot Market (Kad Luang) & Ton Lamyai Market
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Focus on candid portraits of vendors and shoppers, close-ups of colorful fruits, spices, and flowers. Look for interesting textures and light playing through the stalls.

places.name: Elephant Nature Park
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Focus on natural behaviors: elephants splashing in the river, mothers and babies, and close-up portraits showing their expressions. Bring a telephoto lens for respectful distance.

places.name: Wat Umong Suan Phutthatham
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Photograph the dimly lit tunnels, focusing on light and shadow play. Explore the surrounding forest for tranquil nature shots and the large stupa.

places.name: Wat Phra Singh Woramahawihan
places.priceRange: Entry Fee: 20 THB (approx. $0.55) for main chapel
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Capture the detailed gables and rooflines, the golden Buddha images, and the vibrant interior murals. The small, wooden library (Ho Trai) is also highly photogenic.

places.name: Monk Chat at Wat Suan Dok
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Focus on candid shots of conversations and interactions. When taking portraits, always ask for permission. The group of white chedis (memorials for royal family) is also very photogenic.

places.name: Huay Tung Tao Lake (Lanna-style Bamboo Huts)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Frame the bamboo huts against the backdrop of the mountains and the lake, especially during golden hour for reflections. Look for people enjoying the scenery for lifestyle shots.

places.name: Chiang Mai University Lake (Ang Kaew)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Photograph the reflection of Doi Suthep in the lake, especially at sunrise or sunset. Capture candid moments of students relaxing or exercising.
